Article 83(1)-(2) requires a post-market surveillance system, which should have actively and systematically gathered data on the device's performance. The lack of retained logs indicates a potential failure in this obligation.
Article 10(9) requires setting up, implementation and maintenance of a post-market surveillance system. The lack of retained logs suggests a failure in this obligation.
Article 10(2) requires establishing and maintaining a risk management system. The regression in VTach sensitivity may have triggered obligations under this article.

report.rationale: The incident resulted in a patient requiring emergency resuscitation following an unflagged ventricular tachycardia episode, which is a serious potential harm scenario.
